face.flavorText: 所谓抄袭，不过是“合理”地利用了你的资源。

face.name: Plagiarize
face.text: Secret: At the end of your opponent's turn, add copies of the cards they played to your hand.
face.flavorText: Copying is just using your resources wisely.

face.name: 裂魂残像
face.text: 奥秘：当你的随从受到攻击时，召唤一个该随从的复制。
face.flavorText: 被人打得灵魂出窍的感觉……还挺迷幻的。

face.name: Splitting Image
face.text: Secret: When one of your minions is attacked, summon a copy of it.
face.flavorText: Sometimes you get punched so hard they see double.

face.name: 紧急机动
face.text: 奥秘：当一个友方随从死亡时，召唤一个它的复制。复制会休眠1回合。
face.flavorText: 桶滚动作！

face.name: Emergency Maneuvers
face.text: Secret: When a friendly minion dies, summon a copy of it. It's Dormant for 1 turn.
face.flavorText: DO A BARREL ROLL!

face.name: 扰咒术
face.text: 奥秘：当一个敌方法术以一个随从为目标时，召唤一个1/3的随从并使其成为新的目标。
face.flavorText: 虽然干扰敌人的闪电箭非常有意思，但是扰咒师更喜欢干扰对手使用野性印记。那种感觉会更卑鄙。至于血精灵...呃，他们只是稍微有点卑鄙而已。

face.name: Spellbender
face.text: Secret: When an enemy casts a spell on a minion, summon a 1/3 as the new target.
face.flavorText: While it's fun to intercept enemy lightning bolts, a spellbender much prefers to intercept opposing Marks of the Wild. It just feels meaner. And blood elves... well, they're a little mean.

face.name: 诱骗诡计
face.text: 奥秘：当一个友方随从受到攻击时，使其获得+3/+3。
face.flavorText: 我的天呐，这种套路怎么总有人上钩！

face.name: Bait and Switch
face.text: Secret: When a friendly minion is attacked, give it +3/+3.
face.flavorText: Oh my god, the bait and switch works every time!

face.name: 压感陷阱
face.text: 奥秘：在你的对手施放一个法术后，随机消灭一个敌方 随从。
face.flavorText: 要能像每天上秤时那么小心翼翼，就不会触发陷阱了。

face.name: Pressure Plate
face.text: Secret: After your opponent casts a spell, destroy a random enemy minion.
face.flavorText: The appropriate dishware for stressful situations.

face.name: 火焰结界
face.text: 奥秘：在一个随从攻击你的英雄后，对所有敌方随从造成 3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 小心玩火，殃及四邻。

face.name: Flame Ward
face.text: Secret: After a minion attacks your hero, deal 3 damage to all enemy minions.
face.flavorText: Not to be confused with the burn ward.

face.name: 法术共鸣
face.text: 奥秘：当你的对手施放一个法术时，将该法术的一张复制置入你的手牌，其法力值消耗变为（0）点。
face.flavorText: 好厉害的法术，我也要！

face.name: Mana Bind
face.text: Secret: When your opponent casts a spell, add a copy to your hand that costs (0).
face.flavorText: Nice spell. YOINK!

face.name: 公正审判
face.text: 奥秘：当一个敌方随从攻击时，将其攻击力和生命值变为1。
face.flavorText: 看，我们不需要陪审团了，这不是正好有个圣骑士嘛！

face.name: Judgment of Justice
face.text: Secret: When an enemy minion attacks, set its Attack and Health to 1.
face.flavorText: Look, we don't need a jury. We've got a paladin right here!

face.name: 狙击
face.text: 奥秘：在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，对该随从造成 6点伤害。
face.flavorText: 伟大的狙击手总是能够正中目标。就像吃下一整块猪肋排。嗯，味道好极了。

face.name: Snipe
face.text: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, deal 6 damage to it.
face.flavorText: A great sniper hits the spot. Just like a delicious flank of boar. Mmmmm.

face.name: 艾泽里特矿脉
face.text: 奥秘：当敌人使用一张在当回合进入手牌的牌时，获取一张它的复制，其法力值消耗为（0）点。
face.flavorText: 每当矿脉附近的大地颤动，那究竟是地震，还是这颗星球的心跳？

face.name: Azerite Vein
face.text: Secret: When the enemy plays a card on the turn that it entered their hand, get a copy that costs (0).
face.flavorText: When the ground trembles near it, are those earthquakes or heartbeats?

face.name: 蕉猾诡计
face.text: 奥秘：当你的对手在一个回合中抽到第二张牌时，将其变形成为一张香蕉。
face.flavorText: 猢狲的赛场哲学：不论私蕉，公事公绊。

face.name: Shenanigans
face.text: Secret: When your opponent draws their second card in a turn, transform it into a Banana.
face.flavorText: It's not personal, it's just monkey business.

face.name: Sacred Trial
face.text: Secret: After your opponent has at least 3 minions and plays another, destroy it.
face.flavorText: You have chosen poorly.

face.name: 审判
face.text: 奥秘：在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，如果他控制至少三个其他随从，则将其消灭。
face.flavorText: 你的选择…是错的。
